techniques.evidence: crates/table-runtime/src/rescue_tests.rs:393 The regression test on the lost-send recovery path says what it 'used to' do, but records no fix-revert control. A grep of the 15 money-control test files for negative control/mutation/revert finds nothing.

crates/table-runtime/src/reached_paypal_tests.rs:545 The structural pin over words.ts uses a quoted-literal needle, not a bare phrase. Its reason ('the only check before a merge') is stated in the asserting file at :533-534.

crates/table-app/tests/gauntlet.rs:2097 The gauntlet reports how often each stage was actually reached next to its verdict, so a generator that stops reaching refusals or settlements cannot pass the predicate vacuously (comment at :2084-2085).

crates/table-app/tests/gauntlet.rs:2043 Parallelism is declared and justified per lane by what the sessions share.

pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: crates/table-runtime/src/authority_tests.rs:642 The test name claims every Action, but it hand-checks 5 of the ~63 Action::command mappings. Its loop at :645-646 only checks each AUTHORITY row against the same table. So a new action wrongly returning None (and so skipping the dispatcher's authority gate) passes a test whose name says it is checked.

techniques.evidence: crates/table-runtime/src/authority_tests.rs:642 The name overstates what the test checks. 'Internal' (command() == None) is pinned only for Handoff and Select (:671-672), and the comment at :643 claims a property the loop does not test.
crates/table-runtime/src/authority_tests.rs:638 The authority matrix declares a floor on how many cells it ran, so a filter that selects nothing cannot pass green.

crates/table-runtime/src/deadline_and_attention_tests.rs:142 'A streak is one Fault' is read from a 3.5 s wall-clock window, not from a counted number of failing ticks. On a loaded runner the streak can shrink to one tick and the assertion passes without exercising the dedupe. A pure unit test at :162 covers the logic deterministically.
crates/table-runtime/src/tests.rs:405 runtime() hands each test a private in-memory ledger plus an offline transport, and they are thrown away whole.

crates/table-runtime/src/tests.rs:390 Tests never touch the machine-global OS keychain (KeyringVault). actor_runtime_tests.rs:505 asserts that reads do not reach the vault. Minor gap: the temp dir at actor_runtime_tests.rs:602 is removed only on success (:628).

crates/table-runtime/src/authority_tests.rs:618 This T11 test checks that the runtime matches the authority table, the kind of correspondence probe the technique says is most likely tautological. It records no mutation that was shown to turn it red, and no test file in this context records one.
